job_details.job_description: The Machine Learning Engineer will support the development of an Enterprise MLOps Platform, leading the integration and engineering of machine learning models, and providing expert consulting to deploy AI solutions.
responsibilities: Implement scalable and reliable systems to handle model inference.
Deploy and manage machine learning models in production.
Work on containerization and orchestration solutions.
Collaborate with ML scientists, engineers for CI/CD pipelines.
Ensure compliance with data protection regulations.
Document MLOps processes and best practices.
qualifications: Degree or equivalent and typically requires 4+ years of relevant experience.
skills_required: Python, Spark, R, DataBricks, Github, MLFlow, Airflow
benefits: Total Rewards including annual bonus or long-term incentives
job_details.visa_sponsorship: Candidate must be authorized to work in the U.S, now or in the future, without McKesson support.
job_details.education_required: Bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science, Data Science, Information Technology or related OR equivalent experience

company_summary.summary: McKesson is an impact-driven, Fortune 10 healthcare company focusing on making quality care accessible and affordable.
company_summary.candidate_expectations: Candidates should bring new ideas, grow and thrive in shaping future healthcare solutions.
